how it works.

Three simple steps to transform your daily routines into lasting habits.

Step 01

define your ritual

Create habits for any area of your life — fitness, reading, meditation, learning, and more. Set your frequency and goals.

Step 02

track daily

Mark your progress with a single tap. Each completed day adds to your streak and builds momentum.

Step 03

grow with data

Watch your consistency grow with beautiful charts, streak counters, and weekly insights that keep you motivated.
